triality_assessment: PMNS structure is consistent with O(8) triality at the level of TRUE S3-invariants (unitarity row/column sums, Jarlskog J). The diagonal probabilities themselves are NOT S3-invariant under column cycling because they are basis-dependent. The framework's URB #758 P1 prediction holds for true geometric invariants but does NOT hold for basis-dependent quantities. This SHARPENS the prediction: triality lives in the geometric/algebraic invariants, not in any specific basis representation.
